name: 620W N-Type Bifacial Double-Glass Solar Module
tagline: Next-Pinnacle 620W Bifacial Double-Glass Module for Utility & Industrial Scale. The CALLSUN CN620W represents the next pinnacle of N-type monocrystalline technology, achieving a record-high module efficiency of 22.95%. Delivering an ultra-high 620W output, these bifacial double-glass modules combine an optimized high-density architecture with an exceptional -0.28%/°C temperature coefficient to guarantee maximal energy yield and unmatched ROI for large-scale utility and industrial projects.
tech: N-type bifacial monocrystalline silicon · 132 half-cut cells (6×11×2) · 16BB multi-busbar · 2.0+2mm dual-glass construction · IP68 junction box with 3 bypass diodes · Fire Class C
imageAlt: Callsun CN620W N-Type bifacial double-glass solar module front and back view on white background with junction box and MC4 connectors
description: The CALLSUN CN620W modules represent the next pinnacle of our N-type monocrystalline technology, achieving a record-high module efficiency of 22.95%. Delivering an ultra-high 620W power output, these bifacial double-glass modules combine an optimized high-density architecture with an exceptional low temperature coefficient to guarantee maximal energy yield and unmatched ROI for large-scale utility and industrial projects. Built for B2B distributors, EPC installers and utility-scale IPPs who need maximum power density, IEC-certified supply and 30-year linear power warranty.

specs.label: Output Commitment
specs.value: 87.4% output at year 30 (1% first-year + linear degradation thereafter)

benefits.title: Next-Gen N-Type Efficiency
benefits.description: Advanced N-type technology drastically minimizes first-year degradation to just 1% while delivering industry-leading low-light performance. Compared to P-type cells, the CN620W harvests more energy during dawn, dusk and overcast conditions—directly boosting daily yield for utility and industrial deployments where every watt-hour counts toward project IRR.

benefits.title: Massive 620W Bifacial Yield
benefits.description: Combines 620W frontal power with an 80% bifaciality factor, unleashing powerful double-sided generation to maximize lifetime power output. The high-density 132-cell architecture on a 2382mm chassis delivers the highest power-per-rack in the Callsun standard module lineup, reducing BOS cost and accelerating project payback on utility-scale farms.

benefits.title: Optimized Temperature Coefficient
benefits.description: An exceptional Pmax temperature coefficient of -0.28%/°C ensures peak energy harvesting even in scorching and high-temperature climates. Industry-leading thermal performance translates to measurably higher daily yield in desert, tropical and high-irradiance deployments—where traditional P-type modules lose 2-3% more output per degree above 25°C.

benefits.title: Multi-Busbar (MBB) Precision
benefits.description: State-of-the-art multi-busbar technology enhances current collection efficiency, reduces internal resistance, and boosts structural reliability. 16BB cell architecture shortens carrier travel distance, lowers hot-spot risk and improves performance under partial shading—ideal for utility-scale ground mounts with mixed light conditions and O&M simplicity.

benefits.title: Heavy-Duty Dual-Glass Construction
benefits.description: Built with 2.0mm tempered dual-glass, an anodized aluminum frame, and an IP68 junction box to withstand extreme mechanical loads and environmental stress. The dual-glass construction eliminates PID pathways, improves fire performance (Class C) and extends service life beyond 30 years—engineered for hail, snow, sand and salt mist without micro-crack propagation.

benefits.title: Premium 30-Year Warranty Commitment
benefits.description: Secured by a 25-year product warranty and a 30-year linear power warranty, guaranteeing an elite 87.4% power performance at year 30. Combined with 1% first-year degradation and rigorous IEC 61215/61730 + ISO 9001/14001/45001 certification, the CN620W delivers bankable long-term returns for EPCs, IPPs and project finance partners on utility-scale solar farms.
